title: motio check determinism --json
description: Decoded frame hashes compared across render orders and concurrencies. Exit code 3 when frames differ.

reference.description: What every run is compared with: the first run (runs) or a render with a new page per frame (fresh, the first run). Absent in results of older versions, which mean runs.

freshPage.description: Every frame of this run was rendered on a new page.

differingPixels.description: Most pixels any run changed against the first run.

faintPixels.description: Of the differingPixels of the run that changed most, those whose every channel differs by at most 2 levels.

imagePixels.description: Of the differingPixels of the run that changed most, those inside an drawn smaller than its natural size.

region.description: Bounding box of the pixels that differ in any run, in captured pixels.

diagnosis.description: The likely cause, read from which runs disagree and how much of each frame differs; present when frames differ.

cause.description: random: every run differs (Math.random(), a clock); order: ascending and descending differ (a frame depends on the previous one); race: one tab and several tabs differ; history: the runs agree but not with a new page per frame; mixed: more than one; raster: every frame differs in no more than a few lines of pixels, as when Chrome rasterises the same content differently; canvas: every difference lies inside a canvas drawn on the GPU (canvas gpu), where --canvas=software helps; image: the differences lie inside images drawn smaller than their natural size and change by a level or two, as when Chrome draws them from a decoded copy of another size held in its image cache (pattern has what the runs point to otherwise, for raster, canvas and image).

pattern.description: With the raster, canvas or image cause: what the disagreeing runs point to if the composition is the cause.
